extracted.name: Garibaldi cocktail
extracted.description: Blend orange juice and Campari with ice to make a refreshing Campari cocktail. It's the perfect drink for long summer days and garden parties
ingredient_lines: 125ml freshly squeezed orange juice with bits
instruction_lines: Put a handful of ice in a highball glass, then pour over the Campari and orange juice. Stir, then garnish with the orange slice and serve.
